sermon.title: The River and the Word — December 27, 2020
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: This message joins the river of the Spirit and the word. Psalm 1’s blessed person meditates on God’s law and bears fruit in season. Josiah wept when the book of the law was found, made a covenant and purged idolatry; Hezekiah humbled himself under threat. God asks whether His word is our delight and purpose.
